automation_rule: Hourly automation updates JSON data only and never rewrites HTML/JS/CSS/VERSION.

deployment.pages: Deploy committed public/ directly. Do not rebuild the report in Pages workflow.
deployment.android: Generate Android with Capacitor, sync committed public/, apply native branding script, then Gradle build.

apk_icon.design: Very minimal dark navy background with one mint rising line; no text or decorative clutter.

android_back_contract: If a Market Radar modal/popup is open, Back closes it and does not exit the app.
If no modal is open and WebView can go back, Back navigates history.
If there is nowhere to go back, show 앱을 종료하시겠습니까? confirmation.
Exit only after user confirmation through Capacitor App.exitApp().
removed_ui: Custom 1시간/일봉/주봉/월봉 interval buttons. Keep them removed.
